svg.title: hvidom@dublin — neofetch
svg.desc: Terminal: Hryhorii Ilin, full-stack developer and ex-sales director in Dublin. Stack: TypeScript, Bun, Hono, React, Astro, Postgres, Cloudflare. Journey: 2011 Linux and infrastructure, 2015 full-stack developer, 2020 sales director, 2026 building Content Factory.
